action: Issued Stop-Process -Id 7488 -Force after incorrectly identifying that process as the agent's archive text scanner.
exact_shell_command: $auditProcess = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter 'ProcessId=7488'; if ($auditProcess.ParentProcessId -ne 20716 -or $auditProcess.Name -ne 'python.exe') { throw 'Audit process ownership changed' }; Stop-Process -Id 7488 -Force; 'Stopped only the owned text-scan interpreter; retry will stream bounded chunks.'
command_result_text: Stopped only the owned text-scan interpreter; retry will stream bounded chunks.
command_result_text_correction: That ownership assertion was false. PID7488 belonged to the accuracy worker, not the archive scan.
action_time_evidence: The tool transcript does not expose an exact command timestamp. The affected worker started around 2026-10-16T16:26:21.5Z and terminated after 40.172 seconds, approximately 16:27:01.7Z. The agent immediately recognized the PID match when reading the closed worker receipt, informed root and the accuracy agent, and then recorded this report at 16:29:26Z.

preceding_observation.shell_command: Get-Process -Name python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Id,StartTime,CPU,WorkingSet64 | Sort-Object StartTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 10
preceding_observation.mistaken_inference: The agent inferred ownership from the recent start time and apparent memory use while its own read-only archive scan was yielding. Neither property established ownership.

command identity linked to that scan

failed_ownership_check.conclusion: The selected PID and parent belonged to another agent's active accuracy worker. Checking the guessed PID's parent and executable name did not prove ownership.

archive_scan.result: The intended archive scan completed and returned its receipt. Stopping PID7488 did not cancel that scan.

causal_disposition: External intervention by this reviewing agent caused the worker interruption. This is not evidence of an XGBoost, numerical solver, timeout, RSS, headroom or watchdog failure.
preservation_and_authority: Original study receipts and sources remain unchanged. This incident report neither changes the frozen study nor authorizes a timing-policy fallback or study restart. Root and the accuracy agent own recovery. All process-management actions by this agent have stopped.
